title: The Open Eye Theater

services.name: Sound Baths
services.desc: A meditative experience where participants are immersed in vibrational percussive sounds. Participants may either sit in chairs or bring a yoga mat and lie down to listen and relax. Marcel has been involved in the healing arts for over thirty years. Being a professional percussionist, sound healing was a natural connection. Marcel uses the wide range of vibrations of gongs and singing bowls to resonate and heal the mind, body, and spirit.
